seo.title: Who we are and how we work | Humanika
seo.description: Humanika is an initiative of 150 Por Ciento that designs, integrates and runs AI agents for businesses and public institutions, with people in charge.

hero.title: We make AI work with people, not instead of them
hero.description: Humanika is an initiative of 150 Por Ciento. We design, integrate and run AI digital collaborators for businesses and public institutions, with each organization's knowledge and people in charge of decisions.

approach.title: More than a chatbot
approach.description: Three ideas guide every project we do.

items.title: Agents connected to your operations
items.text: A digital collaborator works with your organization's documents, systems, processes, permissions and channels, not just a script.

items.title: People decide
items.text: AI prepares, answers and suggests. Your team reviews, approves and handles the cases that need human judgment.

items.title: Measurable results
items.text: Every agent has usage, resolution and escalation metrics, so you know what works and what to adjust.

method.title: How we take an agent to production
method.description: A four-stage process, from the first use case to daily operations.

items.title: We understand the challenge
items.text: We define the process, the people it serves and the expected outcome together with your team.

items.title: We organize the knowledge
items.text: We gather the documents, sources and rules the agent may use, and what it must not answer.

items.title: We configure and test
items.text: We design the agent, connect it to your channels and systems and test it with real cases before launch.

items.title: We operate and improve
items.text: We monitor conversations and metrics, and adjust the agent as your organization changes.

cta.title: Let's talk about your next digital collaborator
cta.description: Write to us on WhatsApp and we'll reply with a proposal for the process you want to improve.
cta.whatsappMessage: Hi, I'd like to learn more about Humanika and talk to the team.
